lines.text: Soldiers arrested Jesus, bound Him, and brought Him first to Annas, father-in-law of Caiaphas the high priest.
Peter was brought into the courtyard, told the servant girl "I am not," and warmed himself at a charcoal fire.
The high priest questioned Jesus about His disciples and teaching, and Jesus said to ask those who heard Him.
An officer slapped Jesus in the face, and Annas sent Him, still bound, to Pilate the high priest.
Peter denied Jesus again, a servant who saw him in the temple asked, and a rooster crowed immediately.
